# Gevurah — Reality and Constraints

The Awtsmoos gives infinite light a disciplined vessel; truth must precede marketing on Awtsmoos.com.

## Verified
- Peruta purchase is server-authoritative and idempotent.
- Purchased and promotional Peruta are distinct.
- Universal supporter tiers and consumable product-credit packs already exist.
- Generic credit consumption already exists and is tested against concurrency/idempotency.
- The global UI foundation already mounts product commerce.
- 76 catalog products are represented in the front-end catalog while current backend filesystem discovery yields 69 commerce identities.
- Eleven catalog identities are missing from backend discovery; several are external-root routes, one is nested, and one aliases the Captions route.
- Apps/Games hub inventories are dynamically rendered and therefore weak for crawler-visible merchandising.

## Hard Rules
- Never invent client-authoritative prices.
- Never market unavailable fulfillment.
- Never create pay-to-win, gambling, hidden scarcity, or deceptive depletion.
- Never sell credits without a meaningful redemption path.
- Preserve dirty/uncommitted user work.
- Full-file rewrites only; touched source under 120 lines; tabs; no compressed statements.
- Every touched JS starts with exact B"H / Boruch Hashem / Blessed be He lines and extensive JSDoc.
